_what: The limits every formula evaluation is held to before and while the compiled evaluator runs it (evaluation-guards.mjs, applied in evaluate-over-rows.mjs, the one door every caller passes: tool:evaluate-binding, tool:filter-rows-by-rules, the page's computed columns and record filters). A formula past one is refused with its own words, never left to freeze a list.
_max_depth: How deeply a binding's parts may nest (objects and lists inside each other).
_max_nodes: How many parts (objects, lists and values) one binding may hold.
_max_work: Rows times the binding's weight (its parts, a regex op weighing regex_weight): the evaluator's work for one call, known before it starts (the Expansion Library's 23,663 records under a 200-part rule is about 4.7 million). It is the time budget on hosts whose clock does not move while code runs (a Cloudflare Worker), so it holds everywhere.
_regex_ops: The ops that compile a pattern, and the argument holding it. The evaluator's regex engine (Rust regex) runs in linear time, so the risk is a pattern whose compiled form is huge (long, or repeating a group a great many times), compiled again for each row.
_regex_repeat_most: The largest count a pattern may repeat something ({n}, {n,m}); a(b{1000}){1000} compiles to millions of states.
_budget_ms: Wall time one call may take where the clock moves while code runs (a browser page, Node): rows are given to the evaluator rows_per_slice at a time and the call stops between slices once past it. A single evaluation past it marks that formula slow for slow_ms, and it is refused until then.

words.too_deep: This formula nests more than {limit} levels deep.
words.too_large: This formula has more than {limit} parts.
words.cycle: This formula contains itself, so working it out would never end.
words.unsafe_regex: A pattern in this formula is too large to run safely ({why}).
words.too_much_work: This formula over these rows is more work than one evaluation may do ({work} of {limit}); narrow the rows or simplify it.
words.over_time: This formula took longer than {limit} ms to work out and is paused; simplify it or try again later.
